posts.title: What do I want in a Linux distribution?
posts.description: I’ve been a Debian user since 1999, and a Debian developer since 2000 . Given recent events it’s worth thinking about why that that is, and why I haven’t switched to something else in the past quarter century. posts.title: onak 0.6.5 released
posts.description: I had intended that the next release of onak, my OpenPGP keyserver, would be 0.7.0, and include OpenPGP v6 support ( RFC9580 ). However events conspired to make a 0.6.5 release a really good idea. Firstly, I threw an LLM at the code base and asked it to review it.
